prompt: Egocentric view from a wrist-mounted industrial camera on a robotic arm, looking down at its pneumatic suction cup engaging a single sealed plastic clamshell package on a distribution center conveyor. The suction cup's black rubber lip compresses against the package's flat surface, and the arm's aluminium forearm link and bundled air hose enter the frame from the top. The conveyor's black belt is scuffed with use marks, a crooked shipping label is stuck to the belt edge, and the flat overhead LED panels wash the scene in even, shadowless light. Slight motion blur on the package edge from the belt's movement.

Wrist-camera view from a FANUC arm in an engine assembly plant, looking at its parallel-jaw gripper lowering a single cast-iron piston into a cylinder bore on an engine block. The gripper's machined steel jaws bracket the piston's skirt, and the bore's honed crosshatch pattern is visible below. The arm's orange housing and signal cables are at the top of the frame. Cutting oil slicks the block's deck surface, the lighting is a mix of overhead fluorescents and a localised work lamp creating a hard shadow, and a torque wrench and gasket set sit unfocused on the bench edge.

Egocentric frame from a wrist-mounted camera on a cobot in a pharmaceutical packaging line, looking down at its vacuum nozzle placing a single blister pack of pills into a printed cardboard carton. The blister pack's foil-sealed cavities and the carton's folded flaps are in sharp focus at the centre. The arm's light-grey forearm and coiled cable harness are visible at the frame's upper edge. The packaging line's stainless guide rails and a rejected pack in a side chute are at the periphery, and the image has the flat, slightly desaturated quality of a fixed-focus industrial CMOS sensor under cool white strip lighting.

Wrist-camera capture from a robotic arm in a ceramics factory, looking at its foam-padded gripper clamping a single unfired clay bowl on a kiln loading tray. The bowl's raw terracotta surface shows faint throwing rings, and the gripper's two contoured pads squeeze the bowl's rim gently. The arm's cable trunk and a pneumatic fitting are at the top of the frame. The kiln's open mouth glows dull orange behind the tray, and fine clay dust coats the camera lens edge, softening the upper-right corner. The lighting is uneven—warm from the kiln, cold from the ceiling tubes.

Egocentric view from a standard wrist camera on a palletising arm, looking along its own extended forearm as the flat-plate gripper releases a single sack of animal feed onto a stretch-wrapped pallet. The sack's printed label and stitched seam are readable, and the gripper's rubber pads separate from the sack's surface by a centimetre. The arm's hydraulic lines and junction block dominate the left side. The warehouse floor's painted lane markings and a low metal safety fence are at the bottom edge, and the image has slight JPEG compression artefacts and a thin band of chromatic aberration along the sack's bright edge.

Wrist-camera frame from a robotic arm in a glass-bottle recycling plant, looking at its electromagnetic end effector releasing a single green wine bottle onto a cullet conveyor. The bottle drops an inch below the magnet plate, caught mid-fall, and the arm's steel housing and wiring are at the top of the frame. The conveyor is littered with broken glass fragments catching the overhead light, and the image has a slight green cast from the tinted glass reflecting onto the camera sensor. A conveyor speed readout is stickered to the guide rail.

Egocentric still from a wrist-mounted camera on a cobot tending a CNC milling machine, looking at its three-jaw chuck gripper extracting a single machined aluminium bracket from the machine's vice. The bracket's milled faces and drill holes are in focus, and coolant drips from the part onto the machine bed below. The arm's grey forearm and the gripper's knurled jaw faces are at the frame's top. Metal chips and a pool of milky coolant cover the bed, and the CNC's internal work light gives the image a cold bluish cast with hard specular reflections on the wet surfaces.

Wrist-camera view from a robotic arm on a tyre-mounting line, looking at its expanding collet tool gripping the inner bead of a single black rubber tyre lying flat on a roller table. The collet's steel segments press outward against the bead, and the tyre's sidewall DOT markings and tread grooves are in detail. The arm's wrist joint and encoder cable are at the top edge. The roller table's chrome cylinders and a stack of alloy wheels are in the mid-ground, and the lighting is harsh bay lighting from high above, creating a strong top-down shadow beneath the tyre.

Egocentric capture from a wrist camera on a pick-and-place arm in a bakery packaging line, looking at its soft silicone suction cup lifting a single frosted cupcake from a cooling rack. The suction cup dimples the cupcake's paper liner, and a smear of pink frosting is visible on the cup's rubber lip from a previous cycle. The arm's white food-grade housing and a stainless-steel air fitting are at the top of the frame. The cooling rack's wire grid and rows of other cupcakes fill the background, and the factory's fluorescent lighting flattens every shadow. A hairnet-clad worker is a blurred shape at the far edge.

Wrist-camera frame from a robotic arm in an e-commerce returns processing centre, looking at its parallel-jaw gripper pulling a single used smartphone from a sorting bin. The phone's cracked screen and scuffed aluminium frame are in focus between the gripper's rubber pads, and the arm's forearm and cable loom enter from above. The bin contains other loose electronics—chargers, earbuds, a tablet—visible below the phone. The image has the flat, noise-speckled quality of a budget industrial camera in mixed fluorescent and daylight from a loading-dock door at the frame's edge.

Fish-eye egocentric view from a ceiling-mounted camera above a KUKA robotic arm, looking straight down as the arm's magnetic end effector lifts a single steel disc brake rotor from a machining pallet. The rotor's ventilation slots and machined face are at the centre, and the arm's orange joints radiate outward. The fish-eye barrel distortion curves the pallet edges and the factory floor into a bowl shape, and the surrounding workstations, tool racks, and safety-yellow floor tape warp at the periphery. The lighting is uneven industrial bay lighting with one dead tube creating a dark stripe across the left side.

Fish-eye egocentric frame from a wide-angle lens mounted on the base of a robotic arm in a fulfilment warehouse, looking upward along the arm's full length as its vacuum gripper descends toward a single brown parcel on a conveyor. The arm's joints and cables stretch vertically through the centre of the frame, and the warehouse ceiling's sprinkler pipes and cable trays curve dramatically at the edges. The parcel and conveyor are at the bottom, warped into a concave arc. The image has the characteristic radial light falloff of a cheap fish-eye, darker at the corners.

Fish-eye overhead capture from a safety-monitoring camera above a spot-welding cell, looking down at a robotic arm pressing its electrode tips against a single seam on a car roof panel. The weld spark is a blown-out white flare at the centre, and the arm's heavy cables and the roof panel's pressed contours curve outward with the lens distortion. The welding cell's mesh safety cage, warning placards, and a fire extinguisher are stretched and bent at the frame's far edges. The image is slightly smoky from weld fumes, and the lens has a fine layer of spatter dust.

Fish-eye egocentric view from a camera mounted at the shoulder joint of a palletising robot, looking along the full arm as it stacks a single cardboard case onto a pallet. The arm extends diagonally across the frame, its orange segments and the case in its gripper at the far end. The warehouse floor, adjacent pallets, and roller conveyors curve dramatically around the edges. The image has the green-tinted, slightly soft quality of an industrial fish-eye IP camera, with a visible ONVIF timestamp and frame counter burned into the lower-left corner.

Fish-eye overhead view from a ceiling camera above a robotic arm in a produce packing shed, looking down as the arm's suction cup picks a single mango from a grading belt. The mango's blush-red skin is at the centre, the suction cup compressing its surface slightly. The belt's other mangoes curve away in a warped arc, and the shed's corrugated-iron roof beams and dangling fly strips stretch at the periphery. The lighting is a mix of natural daylight from open shed walls and a single fluorescent tube, creating uneven exposure with a bright blown-out strip on one side.

Fish-eye egocentric frame from a wide-angle camera on the base column of a SCARA arm in a PCB assembly cell, looking upward as the arm's vacuum nozzle places a single surface-mount component onto a circuit board. The arm's horizontal linkages and the tiny component at the nozzle tip are at the centre, and the clean-room ceiling tiles and HEPA vents curve into a dome above. The board's green solder mask and copper traces warp at the bottom edges. The image is clinical and overlit by the ring light on the arm's tool, with the surrounding workstation curving away in distortion.

Fish-eye overhead capture from a ceiling-mounted monitoring camera in a cold-storage warehouse, looking down at a robotic arm's fork-style gripper sliding under a single frozen pallet of boxed seafood. The pallet's shrink-wrapped cartons and the gripper's steel tines are at the centre, and the frosted concrete floor and tall racking aisles curve away on all sides. Ice crystals on the camera's dome housing create a soft haze ring around the frame's edge. The image is underexposed with visible noise from the cold-storage LED strips, and the temperature reads -18°C on a wall-mounted digital display warped at the frame's corner.

Fish-eye egocentric view from a dome camera above a robotic arm in a sawmill, looking down as its log-turning claw rotates a single debarked pine log on a carriage. The log's pale wood grain and the claw's hydraulic fingers are at the centre, and the sawmill's blade housing, sawdust chute, and conveyor belt curve dramatically at the edges. The image has a yellow-brown tint from sawdust coating the dome, and bark fragments and wood chips litter every surface. A spray of coolant water from the blade guard catches the overhead light as a bright streak.

Fish-eye overhead frame from a monitoring camera above a robotic arm in a solar-panel assembly line, looking down as the arm's suction array lifts a single photovoltaic cell from a cassette tray. The cell's dark blue silicon surface and silver bus bars are at the centre, and the arm's aluminium crossbar and four suction cups frame the cell. The assembly line's other stations, wire-bonding tools, and junction-box fixtures curve away at the edges. The image is evenly lit by diffused clean-room panels, but the fish-eye distortion makes the far workstations appear miniaturised and curved.

Fish-eye egocentric capture from a wide-angle lens on the pillar base of a robotic arm in a paint-mixing warehouse, looking upward as the arm's hook attachment lifts a single five-gallon paint bucket by its wire handle from a shelf. The bucket's label and the hook's steel curve are at the centre, and the arm's segments and cables extend vertically above. The warehouse shelving, stacked paint cans, and colour-sample charts on the wall warp into a tunnel shape at the edges. The image has a slight magenta shift from the mixed mercury-vapour and LED overhead lighting, and a drip of dried white paint runs down the camera's dome housing.
